verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents ClawHub, a public registry for discovery, install, publish and security. Native `openclaw skills` commands search, install, update and verify skills from ClawHub, Git or local directories, and plugins can be installed from ClawHub, some without restarting. A community report that a top ClawHub skill was briefly a malware installer confirms the registry is real and actively used, though it signals vetting risk. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of the one-command install flow working end to end, and any evidence of click-based browsing or install in the Control UI.
